title: Rendezvous with the ISS
schemeLabel: Scheme seen from above the orbit: the Earth, the ship's orbit, the ISS orbit and the phase angle between them

explain.phasing: The ship flies on a lower orbit, which is faster, so every orbit it gains on the ISS. It waits until the ISS is just the right angle ahead.
explain.transfer: Two engine burns raise the ship from its orbit to the ISS orbit along half an ellipse.
explain.approach: The ship is on the ISS orbit: final approach, checks and waiting for a contact with mission control.
explain.docked: The ship is docked to the ISS. The crew can start unloading the cargo.
explain.notDocked: The ship did not reach the ISS: it ran out of propellant or time. The report explains why.
